sources.entry: Equibles - US stock market data for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants through a hosted MCP server and a REST API, covering SEC filings, financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades and 13F holdings. #freemium #mcp

summary.name: Equibles
summary.one_liner: Equibles is a stock research platform offering SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, insider, congressional and 13F data, and an AI analyst (ALVIS), with a hosted MCP server for connecting AI assistants.
use_cases: Research US stocks using SEC filings and earnings calls
Connect Claude or ChatGPT to financial data
Screen the US market with plain-English rules
summary.what_it_does: The page describes access to SEC filings, financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades, 13F holdings, prices and short data for US stocks, with listings in Europe, China, Hong Kong, Japan and Canada. ALVIS, its AI analyst, answers questions in plain English and cites a source for each figure. A hosted MCP server exposes about 136 research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other compatible AI apps, and a REST API is also mentioned. The site also offers a plain-English stock screener, supply-chain mapping, a tool that turns web pages into self-updating datasets, and index rebalance outlooks. Screener results can be exported as CSV for Excel or Google Sheets.
notable: Hosted MCP server giving AI assistants about 136 research tools, with sign-in instead of an API key
Every extracted figure is cited to its primary source such as SEC EDGAR or FINRA
Predictive models (e.g., FINRA short-interest estimates) kept separate from official reported data
Earnings call transcripts for listings in several countries, each in the call's original language
caveats: Screener's advanced features such as nested AND/OR groups and formula comparisons are described as Pro-only
Usage limits and paid tiers apply beyond the free allowance; exact prices are on the pricing page and not shown here
Research is informational only and the service does not place trades
